ig_caption:
A pile of PDFs is not knowledge. Links are 🔗

Most companies: a shared drive with "Refund_Policy_FINAL.pdf", "FINAL_v2", "old DO NOT USE". An agent can't tell which one is true.

The same knowledge as an Obsidian-style vault:
📄 one note per topic
👤 an owner + last-reviewed date on every note
🔗 links between notes + an index page

That's what we do at work: experts upload their documents, we turn them into a vault the agent can follow.

Part 2/5 of AI Second Brain. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
